text: The authors state the main contribution is the benchmark and the experiments are small and demonstrative, with 100 questions, one judge model (gpt-4o-mini) and five agent configurations, and that future work should cover more agent and judge models and more questions for statistical significance, with reasoning models such as deepseek-r1 and o3 as agents.
